scope: Integrity, composition, and 25 km geographic-overlap audit of the public Zhao et al. (2025) Sentinel-2 L1C methane-retrieval dataset before any model use.

paper.citation: Zhao et al. (2025), A data-efficient deep transfer learning framework for methane super-emitter detection using high-resolution satellite imagery, Atmospheric Chemistry and Physics 25, 4035-4050

sites.coordinate_note: Table 2 also reports a second pipeline coordinate at 31.768, 6.000; both coordinates are included in the distance audit.

mars_overlap_contract.distance: great-circle haversine distance between the frozen Zhao coordinates and unique MARS physical-location coordinates
mars_overlap_contract.eligibility: A Zhao site is eligible for auxiliary model development only if every listed coordinate is strictly farther than 25 km from every MARS physical location in every development and official-test split.
mars_overlap_contract.official_test_policy: Any site at or within 25 km of a MARS paper-test location is permanently prohibited from training, calibration, model selection, and claimed independent evaluation.
mars_overlap_contract.development_policy: Any site at or within 25 km of a MARS development location is excluded from auxiliary training for the current folds 3/4 model-selection campaign.
mars_overlap_contract.all_site_policy: If no site passes the all-MARS boundary, the archive remains research evidence only and contributes zero training examples.

allowed: Verify hashes, byte size, member safety, member counts, class directories, image dimensions, and image modes.
Decode images only after this protocol is committed and only for integrity/statistical audit.
Write compact reports; keep archive and extracted images ignored.
forbidden: Do not fit, tune, calibrate, score, or select any model during the acquisition audit.
Do not use a Zhao image whose site fails the frozen geographic eligibility rule.
Do not commit the archive, extracted PNGs, caches, embeddings, or checkpoints.
Do not claim dense-mask supervision; the public archive contains class-organized retrieval-map PNGs, not pixel masks.

claim_boundary: This audit can establish integrity, composition, and development eligibility only. It cannot establish model improvement, independent generalization, or superiority to MARS-S2L.
